label: Why this school
description: Asks what draws you to this specific program, curriculum, or city.

label: Diversity & perspective
description: Asks what you bring to the community, or about engaging with people unlike you.

label: Adversity & challenge
description: Asks about a setback, failure, difficult feedback, or a belief that got tested.

label: Gap year & updates
description: Asks what you have been doing since graduating or since submitting AMCAS.

label: Ethical dilemma
description: Asks how you handled a situation with competing values or incomplete information.

label: Leadership & advocacy
description: Asks about leading a team, advocating for someone, or driving change.

label: Future goals
description: Asks where you see your career going and why you need an MD to get there.

label: Community & service
description: Asks about volunteer work, underserved populations, or contribution to a community.

label: Clinical experience
description: Asks specifically about patient-facing or healthcare work.

label: Research
description: Asks you to describe a research project, your role, and what it taught you.

label: Personal background
description: Asks about upbringing, family, curiosity, or who you are outside medicine.

label: Reapplicant
description: Asks what has changed since your last application.

label: Open-ended
description: The catch-all: anything else the committee should know.

label: Administrative
description: Not really an essay: scheduling, disclosures, transcript explanations.
